state: This task specifies failure behavior without executing tests, compiling code, starting services or benchmarking. Can is written by AI agents and must retain full ordinary functions; scenarios, comparison rules, scheduling and reduction belong to Can instead of foreign harnesses. R is the qualified compiler/runtime for the suite, C is the candidate subject, and N is the external native owner supervising fresh Bun workers and the Can controller. N enforces limits, records execution facts and reclaims resources but cannot supply an expectation verdict. A clean result requires both Can's report and N's release evidence. Agreed capabilities register ownership before effects, distinguish process outcomes from assertions, retain uncertain allocations against budgets and disallow blind replay of ambiguous effects. Qualification covers the retained ledger's entire mandatory environment matrix and all offline assertion roots. Bootstrap uses every root; focused verification is allowed only after its conservative selector is qualified. The authoring proposal maps a nonempty, fully completed selected subset to status 0, ordinary completed mismatches to 1, and unavailable/incomplete/broken or cleanup-failed execution to 2. A required service absent at admission is blocked, whereas loss during a case is an execution fault. An intentionally observed candidate crash or timeout may match the oracle while the reference judge stays healthy and teardown is established; a dead judge leaves missing evidence. Preserve simultaneous mismatches, unperformed checks and cleanup failures. Cancellation stops new work, retains finished observations and externally disposes outstanding resources while listing selected cases never started. Do not continue live cases after uncertain containment or unreleased resources; a contained case failure with confirmed cleanup can permit unrelated work. Reruns must preserve earlier defects. Current source shows a three-slot heavy semaphore and disposable content-addressed suite bundle reuse, verification on hits and bypasses when building is itself tested. The old cache automatically rebuilds after contamination and expires fill locks by age; this is not justification to hide an integrity failure or infer inactivity. Existing tempcache checks owner identity, leases and paths and conservatively uses ps/lsof, but the new lifecycle must preserve failed cleanup ownership across process death. Assertion supervision currently bounds direct workers without establishing all descendant or disk guarantees. The intended first schedule uses one case, one assertion worker and one build producer, charged against finite shared admission, without speculative build overlap; a case's bounded subjects may run concurrently when its scenario needs them. Current lifecycle contexts reach 12-30 minutes, making a ten-minute quick run a subset rather than permission to skip long requirements. Candidate artifacts are reusable only within the current owned run under matching source, dependencies, compiler/runtime, options and target identity, immutable verification and read leases. Fresh-build/determinism/corruption scenarios opt out. Keep no private persistent bundles, destroy partial/complete build allocations during cleanup, and do not treat recovery of an earlier run as a reusable cache.

coverage.instructions: Select the outcome model for missing work, subset runs and independent execution/cleanup facts.

criteria.separate_axes: Use separate coverage, behavior, execution and disposal fields, preserving coexisting failures; a completed chosen subset may succeed locally but omitted or blocked required work prevents qualification.
criteria.single_terminal: Prefer a single ordered outcome enum per case and aggregate it, with secondary execution/cleanup details retained only as explanatory diagnostics.
criteria.environment_optional: Let missing services reduce the effective selection at runtime and define success over the remaining runnable cases, retaining a skipped-environment list.

continuation.instructions: Choose a continuation rule for local faults, interrupted execution and uncertain cleanup.

criteria.containment_gated: Permit unrelated ready cases after a failed case is fully isolated and disposed, but halt new live work when shared trust, ownership, reporting or user cancellation makes continuation unsafe.
criteria.always_fail_fast: End admission at the first failed case of any kind, regardless of whether its resources and trust boundary are healthy.
criteria.budget_only: Let available time and worker capacity govern continuation even after unresolved cleanup, with warnings and error outcomes preserved in the report.

reuse.instructions: Select artifact lifetime and contamination behavior for shared candidate builds.

criteria.same_run_verified: Share verified complete artifacts under exact keys and leases inside one run; build once per reusable input, bypass for independent-build obligations, and surface contamination without silently rebuilding it away.
criteria.fresh_every_case: Always regenerate each case's inputs and output bundle instead of memoizing successful builds, accepting duplicate work for isolation.
criteria.repair_hits: Use the current disposable cache approach with automatic miss/rebuild behavior when a previously ready entry fails validation, prioritizing progress over a distinct integrity failure.
